newsitem.title: USA: Layoffs likely at Georgia-Pacific - paper.
newsitem.headline: Layoffs likely at Georgia-Pacific - paper.

text.p: Georgia-Pacific Corp is likely to lay off hundreds of workers from its building products distribution division in the coming months, the Atlanta Journal- Constitution reported on Wednesday.

About 50 employees, mostly in Atlanta and Denver, found out they had lost their jobs on Monday. In subsequent meetings with management, the division's remaining 5,750-strong work force was told there would be more layoffs to come.
The newspaper quoted a company spokeswoman as saying cuts over the next few months would be aggressive, amounting to tens of millions of dollars in intended payroll savings.
Georgia-Pacific officials were not immediately available to comment on the report.
The newspaper said a $400 million restructuring of the division, implemented in mid-1994, had been expected to avert major layoffs by concentrating on streamlining operations.

But the division posted an undisclosed operating loss in 1995 and the newspaper said that by the third-quarter of 1996, division losses already had surpassed projections for the entire year while restructuring costs stood at nearly double expectations.
